kept.q: A rectangular wooden box (cuboid) has length 8 cm, breadth 5 cm and height 4 cm. Find the volume of the box.
kept.explanation: Volume of a cuboid = length x breadth x height = 8 x 5 x 4 = 160 cm^3.
kept.pidgin: Volume of cuboid na length x breadth x height, so 8 x 5 x 4 give 160 cm^3.

kept.q: A solid cube has each edge measuring 6 cm. Find the total surface area of the cube.
kept.explanation: Total surface area of a cube = 6 x (side)^2 = 6 x 6^2 = 6 x 36 = 216 cm^2.
kept.pidgin: Total surface area of cube na 6 times side squared; 6 x 36 = 216 cm^2.

kept.q: A cylindrical water pipe has a radius of 7 cm and a height of 10 cm. Using pi = 22/7, find the volume of the cylinder.
kept.explanation: Volume of a cylinder = pi r^2 h = 22/7 x 7^2 x 10 = 22 x 7 x 10 = 1540 cm^3.
kept.pidgin: Volume of cylinder na pi r^2 h; 22/7 x 49 x 10 come give 1540 cm^3.

kept.q: A cone has base radius 3.5 cm and slant height 10 cm. Using pi = 22/7, find the curved surface area of the cone.
kept.explanation: Curved surface area of a cone = pi r l = 22/7 x 3.5 x 10 = 11 x 10 = 110 cm^2.
kept.pidgin: CSA of cone na pi x r x l; 22/7 x 3.5 x 10 come give 110 cm^2.

kept.q: A rectangular water tank, open at the top, has internal length 12 m, breadth 8 m and height 5 m. Find the total surface area of the material (base and the four walls) needed to construct the tank.
kept.explanation: Since the tank has no top, total surface area = base + 4 walls = lb + 2(lh + bh) = (12x8) + 2[(12x5)+(8x5)] = 96 + 200 = 296 m^2.
kept.pidgin: Since the tank no get top, total surface area na base plus di four walls = (12x8) + 2[(12x5)+(8x5)] = 96 + 200 = 296 m^2.

q.q: A solid sphere has radius 6 cm. Using pi = 22/7, find the volume of the sphere to the nearest whole number.
q.explanation: Volume of a sphere = 4/3 x pi x r^3 = 4/3 x 22/7 x 216 = 904.57..., which rounds to 905 cm^3.
q.pidgin: Volume of sphere na 4/3 pi r cube; e go give 904.57 wey round reach 905 cm^3.
